title: Build your own chess engine
tagline: Nine test-driven stages from bitboards and magic bitboards to Perft-verified move generation, alpha-beta search, transposition tables, and UCI.
description: Implement a complete C++23 chess engine under include/chess/, one stage at a time, against a doctest suite that stops at the first failing stage. You pair a 64-square mailbox with 64-bit bitboards, take sliding attack generation from ~20 ns naive rays to <1 ns fancy magic bitboards, build incremental make/unmake with Zobrist hashing, verify legal move generation against Perft ground truth, and climb from static evaluation to quiescence search, transposition tables, and a working UCI binary.

stages.title: Board representation and FEN
stages.summary: Keep a 64-square mailbox and piece/color bitboards in sync, and parse and serialize FEN strings with std::expected.

stages.title: Bitboards, directional shifts and naive sliders
stages.summary: Implement if-constexpr directional shifts without wrap-around, consteval leaper tables, ASCII debugging, and unary-fold naive sliding attacks.

stages.title: Magic bitboards: from 20ns to 1ns
stages.summary: Replace ~20 ns ray loops with <1 ns fancy magic bitboards using relevancy masks, Carry-Rippler subsets, sparse magics, and hardware PEXT.

stages.title: Make, unmake and Zobrist hashing
stages.summary: Apply and undo every chess move type in place using an UndoState snapshot while updating a Zobrist key incrementally.

stages.title: Legal move generation and perft
stages.summary: Generate all legal moves including castling, promotions, and en passant pins, and match Perft counts across benchmark positions.

stages.title: Static evaluation
stages.summary: Score positions from the side to move using material values, color-mirrored piece-square tables, and endgame king activity.

stages.title: Alpha-beta search and quiescence
stages.summary: Implement negamax with alpha-beta pruning, MVV-LVA capture ordering, quiescence search, and distance-to-mate scoring.

stages.title: Transposition table and iterative deepening
stages.summary: Cache search bounds in a power-of-two transposition table with ply-normalized mate scores, iterative deepening, and time/node limits.

stages.title: UCI protocol and draw detection
stages.summary: Detect threefold repetition, fifty-move, and insufficient-material draws, and speak the Universal Chess Interface over stdin/stdout.
